items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: I think — do you know Adrian Cunningham? Yeah, he’s killer. I see him quite a bit on the festival circuit.

ctx.x: Do you play the saxophone as well?

I haven’t touched a saxophone since high school. I used to play tenor in the jazz band. No, there’s a lot of great sax players out there. I guess if I’m to play a different instrument I’ve always had more of an interest in doing the guitar or the piano besides the clarinet. There’s a lot of killer doublers out there. I think — do you know Adrian Cunningham? Yeah, he’s killer. I see him quite a bit on the festival circuit. He plays all the woodwinds. And as far as woodwinds go I’m pretty much stuck with the horn,…
Well it’s another case to carry too. Who needs that?
